title: Discount calculation returns 500
incident_description: After the checkout request refactor, orders without an optional promo_code fail before pricing is calculated.
logs:
ERROR checkout.request order_id=ord-1042
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'
ground_truth: A null handling regression calls strip on an absent promo code
recommended_fix: Normalize a missing promo code before string operations and add a regression test.
